cap: Each virus persists in a different place, which predicts its behavior. HIV integrates into resting CD4 cells, so no drug clears it. Herpes simplex hides in sacral ganglia and reactivates, and acyclovir cannot reach it there. HPV stays in basal keratinocytes, where the L1 virus-like particle vaccine prevents infection and imiquimod treats warts. Molluscum is a cytoplasmic poxvirus whose widespread form signals advanced HIV.
